description: This file contains implementations of C++20's bitwise math functions, including rotate, count leading/trailing zeros, popcount, and bit width calculations, with conditional use of standard library features or internal implementations.

methods.name: rotl
methods.description: Performs a rotate left operation on an unsigned integer.

methods.name: rotr
methods.description: Performs a rotate right operation on an unsigned integer.

methods.name: countl_zero
methods.description: Counts the number of leading zero bits in an unsigned integer.

methods.name: countl_one
methods.description: Counts the number of leading one bits in an unsigned integer.

methods.name: countr_zero
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zero bits in an unsigned integer.

methods.name: countr_one
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing one bits in an unsigned integer.

methods.name: popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an unsigned integer.

methods.name: has_single_bit
methods.description: Checks if a number is a power of two.

methods.name: bit_width
methods.description: Returns the position of the highest set bit (bit width).

methods.name: bit_floor
methods.description: Returns the largest power of two less than or equal to x.

methods.name: bit_ceil
methods.description: Returns the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x.
